purpose: The runtime stop chain: one row per stop, each bound to the archived runs that establish it. Validated by scripts/check-stop-chain.py, which refuses a row that claims more than its cited archives show. This is a record-consistency gate, NOT a fidelity claim and NOT proof that a run reached the title screen.

stops.note: A complete 4482-byte C++ virtual method with no analysis-database entry, reached only as slot 2 of the .rdata vtable at 0x001CD290. Zero rel32 callers. Both cited runs log an ABI-verified return.
g03 found it as an unresolved call and did NOT execute it; g05 executed it. stack_args 8 is INFERRED, not derived: seven indirect calls on the walk leave the depth unresolved.
g04 found it; g05 confirmed it. Zero rel32 callers, one .data reference at 0x001FA1C0.

A this-adjusting thunk ending in `jmp [ecx+0x6c]`, so its cleanup is the tail target's `ret 0xc`. g05 FOUND it and does not descend from its own repair commit, which is why it is cited as `discovered` there and not as a confirmation. g06 ran 905 s and never reached it -- recorded as not_exercised, which is not a pass. g07 and g08 both confirmed it.

An under-wide span that cut its own jump table at 0x000B5F0F, so the lifter emitted RECOMP_ITAIL and the guest trapped on the 0xB5F82 arm. Repaired from the bytes by 64945a3, then NOT exercised by two consecutive runs (g07 found it, g08 aborted at 0x48DB0 first). CONFIRMED at last by f9, which descends from the repair and logs its ABI-verified return. Note g07 does NOT descend from 64945a3 either, which is why it is cited as `discovered` and never as a confirmation.

g08 measured `ABI FAILURE 0x00048DB0 esp 00F7FE50->00F7FDA8 expected +4`, an observed delta of -0xA8 that is exactly its prologue (`sub esp,0x98` plus four pushes). Repaired by 892dd1e to end 0x000496B7 with stack_args 8. g08 does NOT descend from the repair, so it is cited only as `discovered`; f9 confirms the ABI-verified return.

A PROVED static production defect (TR section 17): its declared end 0xB0811 is a tail_jump_alias start inside its own body, so its epilogue at 0xB09DC lay outside the span and the emitted body called the fatal trap stub sub_000B09DC TWICE and sub_000B09D9 FOUR times. (An earlier revision of this row, of TR section 17 and of the plan had those two counts reversed; the erratum is TR section 18. The counts here are re-measured from the archived pre-repair body in the g08 source.zip.) Repaired as end 0xB09E0. NO archived run has been observed to reach it, so it has no evidence rows and cannot claim any runtime state. The evidence list is empty on purpose: an empty list is checked, and it is not a pass.

An uncovered pointer in the same .data table 0x1F97B4 that owns 0x00048DB0. Added as [0x00048690, 0x000488AA) with stack_args 8, derived from the bytes. Never dispatched in any archived run, so it has no runtime evidence and claims none.

The row is keyed on the repaired ENTRY 0x000AE560, not on 0x000AE655: the latter is this function's shared epilogue (`pop esi` at 0xAE5ED, `ret 4` at 0xAE5EE), reached by seven conditional branches from inside the body, and it is never entered as a function, so it can never have an ABI-verified return line of its own. The declared end 0x000AE5F1 cut that epilogue off, so the lifter emitted a trap for 0x000AE655 and f9 logged `[ICALL] Failed to resolve VA 0x000AE655` with 0x000AE560 as ICALL-history frame 15. The end is now 0x000AE659 and stack_args 4 was already correct (both exits are `ret 4` at depth 0). f10, which descends from the repair 0445a80, logs 0x000AE560's ABI-verified return and confirms it. This is the first stop the structural census predicted before any run reached it.

An unowned gap: no manifest span, no owner and no dispatch tuple, so an indirect call to it trapped. f10 logged `[ICALL] Failed to resolve VA 0x00096560` (with 0x00096560 as ICALL-history frame 15), which is the DISCOVERY. Recovered as [0x00096560, 0x000967AA) with stack_args 4 from a fully enumerated walk (two exits, both `ret 4` at 0x967A7, at least one at depth 0); its only image reference is the aligned .rdata dword at 0x001CD32C. The recovery landed in fc6f2d4. CONFIRMED by f12, which descends from that commit and logs `[RECOVERED] 0x00096560 returned; ABI verified`. Discovery and confirmation are two different runs and are cited as such.

The sibling of 0x00096560: no manifest span, no owner and no dispatch tuple, with a byte-identical prologue. Recovered as [0x00096B60, 0x00096DBA) with stack_args 4 from a fully enumerated 180-instruction walk (two exits, both `ret 4` at 0x96DB7, one at depth 0); its only image reference is the aligned .rdata dword at 0x001CD3AC. The recovery landed in 46f5c48. CONFIRMED by f13, which descends from that commit and logs the ABI-verified return.

The 927-instruction gap immediately after 0x00080BD0's corrected end 0x00081853, separated from it by thirteen NOP bytes and tail-jumped to by two manifest entries (0x00082770, 0x00082790). f13 logged `[ICALL] Failed to resolve VA 0x00081860` after confirming stop 27. Recovered as [0x00081860, 0x0008274B) with stack_args 4: five exits, all `ret 4`, at least one at depth 0. The repair is in the working tree; no run has executed it, so the state stays REPAIRED, the evidence stays `discovered`, and the row carries no repair_commit until one exists.

The fatal `[ICALL] Failed to resolve VA 0x00159330` that ends the title run (0xE0424943) after the method-admission class clears. Unlike every earlier stop this one is NOT a mis-sized or swallowed span: the function has no analysis-database entry at all, because it is reached ONLY by an indirect call, so no direct call site ever recorded it and no decode pass saw it. The address is a complete function: 0x00159321-0x0015932F is NOP padding, 0x00159330 begins a clean prologue (push ecx; push esi; mov esi,[esp+0xC]), the body runs to 0x00159416 `ret 0xc`, and 0x00159419-0x0015941F is further NOP padding before the next function at 0x00159420. Recovered as [0x00159330, 0x00159419) with stack_args 12 -- the epilogue returns 12 bytes of arguments, and check-stack-depth.py reported DEFECT/STACK_ARGS when that was first omitted, so the gate is what caught it. First reproduced in 20261007-122836-322-title008-witness-1A30-long (unhandled_exception at 624 s, the same failure at the end of the 900 s budget). The repair is in the working tree and has not yet been exercised by a run that gets past it, so the state stays REPAIRED and no repair_commit is recorded.
